items.title: Michael Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 22, 2021
items.q: I have a lot of Jackie McLean records but I don’t have them all.

ctx.x: I see a collection of LPs behind you. And I know I used to spend many hours reading liner notes and almost like keeping track of how many LPs does Clark Terry show up on? And that kind of thing. And I wondered if you did that and did you envision some day seeing your name? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

No. I didn’t really think like that. I’m not — I have a lot of records here but I’m not really a real record collector. I’m not a completist, you know. I have a lot of Jackie McLean records but I don’t have them all. I have a lot of records of particular artists but there are some that I don’t have that maybe a lot of people have in their collections, I just didn’t get around to it. I never really — I never really thought of like, okay one day I’m going to have a hit record, I’m going to do everything I can to be…

You’ve played with a long list of really accomplished saxophonists, in particular. And I wondered if we started with Johnny Griffin, did he tell you what he wanted if he wasn’t getting it? Or did he pretty much let you do your thing?
